history.summary: A 22-year-old, large 1,259 sqft 3BR at a low $1,168 PSF and an absolute $1.47M entry — the cheapest unit in this batch. Value is real but the asset is dated, ~960m from MRT in a quiet enclave, and lacks any clear catalyst, so the upside is steady-not-spectacular and exit will rely on price-sensitive HDB upgraders.
history.rating_rationale: Strengths: sub-$1.5M absolute price sits in the deepest buyer band, $1,168 PSF is genuinely cheap for a 1,259 sqft unit, 598-unit development gives decent liquidity, and MMR 1527 / score 652 is solid. Weaknesses: 2004 build (now 22yo, ~77yr lease left) means rising maintenance and a shrinking finance window for future buyers, the 960m/12-min MRT walk is a real friction in car-light D18, and no URA appreciation data is attached so the growth case is unverified. No specific catalyst (no new MRT within reach, no govt zone) to drive outperformance.
red_flags: 22-year-old building (~77yr lease) — rising maintenance, narrowing buyer finance window over a 5-7yr hold
960m / 12-min walk to Upper Changi MRT — weak connectivity for the area
No URA appreciation / transaction data attached — growth trajectory unverified
Resident complaints of early-morning gardening/leaf-blower noise
catalysts: Sub-$1.5M absolute entry keeps it in the deep HDB-upgrader buyer pool
Low $1,168 PSF leaves headroom if D18 (Tampines/Pasir Ris) continues to firm
Large 1,259 sqft layout appeals to families priced out of newer, smaller units

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Moderate. Large older 3BR rents to families but the tenant pool here is thinner than near-MRT or CBD-adjacent stock; expect ~3% gross yield, unremarkable for investment.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Steady, region-baseline-like. D18 has CRL/Tampines tailwinds but this specific project is far from the station and old; expect roughly OCR-baseline appreciation with limited multiple expansion.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: OCR baseline, no project-specific URA data available
